output.title: Spacious 4-Bedroom Villa with Garden and Double Garage in Differdange
output.description:
This detached villa, constructed in the 1970s, offers approximately 200 square meters of living space within an established residential setting in Differdange. The exterior features a stone facade and encompasses private grounds, including a front lawn and mature garden with a naturalistic design. A double garage adjacent to the residence provides secure parking facilities.

Inside, the property maintains its traditional character, with wood paneling enhancing the warm ambiance of the living room. A central stone fireplace stands as a distinctive element, complementing views over the well-maintained garden. The layout accommodates four bedrooms and two bathrooms, with ample space for varied living arrangements.

Outdoor amenities include a sizable lawn and patio area, ideal for leisure and entertaining. The property also benefits from a cellar, offering additional storage space. Situated in Differdange, Luxembourg's third-largest city with industrial heritage and ongoing residential development, the area combines urban accessibility with a residential atmosphere.

This villa provides a balance of traditional design and private outdoor space, suitable for those seeking established residential accommodation within a dynamic city context.
